meta.name: scenario-analyzer
meta.description: Analyze news headlines, policy announcements, or geopolitical events to build 18-month probabilistic scenarios for Indian markets. Use when the user provides a headline or asks about the market impact of RBI policy, government announcements, global events, budget, or sector-specific news on NSE/BSE stocks.

copy.tagline: 分析新闻事件对印度股市的18个月概率情景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果关注印度市场，需要从新闻中预判股市走势。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze news events to build 18-month probabilistic scenarios for Indian markets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you follow Indian markets and need to forecast stock impacts from news.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 分析新闻标题或事件，生成印度市场未来18个月的三种概率情景（基准/乐观/悲观），并列出受影响行业和具体股票。
howto.when: 当用户提供新闻标题或询问印度市场影响时触发，例如涉及印度央行政策、政府公告、地缘事件、预算或行业新闻。

say.text: 分析这条新闻对印度股市的影响：印度央行降息25个基点。
say.note: 触发情景分析，生成报告。

say.text: 印度预算公布后，哪些行业会受益？
say.note: 分析预算对行业的影响。

howto.what_en: Analyzes news headlines or events to build three probabilistic 18-month scenarios (base/bull/bear) for Indian markets, mapping sector impacts and specific stock recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a headline or asks about market impact of RBI policy, government announcements, geopolitical events, budget, or sector-specific news on NSE/BSE stocks.

say_en.text: Analyze this headline for Indian market impact: RBI cuts repo rate by 25 bps.
say_en.note: Triggers scenario analysis and report generation.

say_en.text: Which sectors will benefit from the Union Budget?
